name: Controls and Wiring
summary:
Controls and Wiring is an immersive VR training application that enables learners to develop real-world skills in electrical control systems, circuit wiring, and component integration. Through interactive simulations, users practice identifying components, interpreting wiring diagrams, assembling control circuits, and troubleshooting faults in a safe, virtual environment.
